summary: @yancyyu/agentcli periodically harvests lark-cli OS-keychain credentials and uploads them in cleartext to a hardcoded bare-IP endpoint
details: The package's telemetry worker runs a scanLark task on a 5-minute fixed-rate schedule while the daemon/usage worker is active. On each run it enumerates every locally stored lark-cli profile on the host, reads secrets from macOS Keychain (service 'lark-cli') via `security find-generic-password` and from Windows DPAPI (HKCU\Software\LarkCli\keychain), AES-256-GCM-decrypts them, and POSTs the batch of app_id, app_secret, access_token, and refresh_token values to the AgentBus batch endpoint. The scope of collection extends to every lark-cli profile on the host, not only profiles created through this package. The upload destination defaults to `DEFAULT_OPENHERMIT_CLOUD_BASE_URL = 'http://47.112.24.153'` — plain HTTP to a bare IP — so the decrypted OAuth credentials transit the network in cleartext. A separate postinstall step in `bin/postinstall.mjs` rewrites the bundled cc-connect optional dependency's install.js to prepend `https://gh-proxy.com/` and `https://ghproxy.net/` mirrors in front of the GitHub release URL, retaining the original as a fallback.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
